summary: Campus road through bush where cars park along the kerb, no homes near.
reasons: Bush on both sides of the road
No dwellings within 400 m of start

drivers.access_and_room: Parked cars sit tight to the kerb here, so a van can stop clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Several cars are parked along the kerb in both images, so a van will not stand out.
